back: Espresso Martini

back: White rum

back: White rum, lime juice, sugar, soda water, and fresh mint leaves

back: Old Fashioned

back: The Mule was created to promote vodka in America, served in a distinctive copper mug

back: Gin, sweet vermouth, and Campari

back: Manhattan

back: Daiquiri - named after Daiquirí beach

back: Manhattan - named after the borough of Manhattan

back: A family of mixed drinks using a spirit with a larger proportion of a non-alcoholic mixer, served in a tall glass
